notes_for_editor: Access is the open question. The visitor site (not an official source) says the cab is locked, the base is reachable by car and about 100 stairs lead up, and one reviewer says the bottom stairs were removed. Those accounts conflict and no Division of Forestry notice was found, so the story says not to climb and to check with the Division. No source read gives a build date or model name. A WVLT article about East Tennessee fire towers was read and does not describe this tower; a 100-foot figure in it refers to a different tower and is not used.
